topic: forge review needs the current Codex CLI on PATH
lesson: Switching the shell to Node 24 via nvm drops the nvm Node 22 bin where codex-cli 0.153 is installed, so autoreview resolves Homebrew's stale codex-cli 0.141, which fails on ~/.codex/config.toml (map where it expects a boolean) and exits 1 with no JSON. Run forge review on the default PATH (or prefix the nvm 22 bin); only verify.py needs Node 24.
